channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-micropython
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: thonny-ai — via awesome-micropython
item.description: Thonny plugin and MCP server that lets AI assistants run code, monitor long-running programs and sync projects on MicroPython boards, visibly and with optional approval.

item.title: ownSQL — via awesome-micropython
item.description: A MySQL database driver for MicroPython, supporting MySQL Server 8.x and 9.x.

item.title: openbricks — via awesome-micropython
item.description: Pybricks-style robotics firmware for ESP32: 1 kHz native drivebase control, serial bus servos, IMU gyro heading, line sensors, plus a MuJoCo simulator.

item.title: micropython-uhf-module — via awesome-micropython
item.description: A MicroPython driver for the Tenhanyun TY928 UHF RFID embedded module.

item.title: micropython-msgpackc — via awesome-micropython
item.description: Fast MessagePack in C, a drop-in replacement for umsgpack.

item.title: coffee-edition-kit — via awesome-micropython
item.description: Pico W firmware that pulls print jobs from GitHub over HTTPS and streams them to a network printer over IPP, for a nightly newspaper.

item.title: anx7625 — via awesome-micropython
item.description: MicroPython porting of video primitives for Portenta H7 via USBC (to HDMI adapter).

item.title: OreoOS — via awesome-micropython
item.description: Operating system for an open-hardware ESP32-S3 conference badge, with an app SDK, on-device app store, OTA updates and native video playback.

item.title: MicroPython-Sharp-Memory-Display — via awesome-micropython
item.description: MicroPython driver for SHARP memory LCD displays.
